text:
Nadia Rivera: FYI while following the onboarding quickstart I hit a 410 for an image in docs/apex/runbook.md. Anyone own that runbook?
docs-bot: link-scan alert (1999990000) detected 1 dead asset in docs/apex/runbook.md (approx line 86). Auto-ticket DOC-1205 created.
Ethan Cole: Can you paste the URL so I can check?
Nadia Rivera: https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/apex-arch-2024.png
Nadia Rivera: curl -I output:
```
$ curl -I https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/apex-arch-2024.png
HTTP/1.1 410 Gone
Date: Fri, 06 Dec 2024 11:22:09 GMT
```
Maya Gomez: Likely a lifecycle purge; design might have an archived export. For quick unblocking we usually rehost small images in docs-site/static/images/ and add a custodian frontmatter.
Ethan Cole: I can take this. Plan: grab from design-uploads or fall back to archived copy, add to /static/images/, update runbook link and add `custodian: docs-apex` in frontmatter. ETA today.
Nadia Rivera: Sounds good. Please also tweak alt text to "Apex architecture overview (simplified)" so screen readers are clear.
Ethan Cole: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-site/pull/3977. sed I used to swap the link:
```bash
sed -i 's|https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/apex-arch-2024.png|/static/images/apex-arch-2024.png|g' docs/apex/runbook.md
```
docs-bot: Linked PR #3977 to DOC-1205.
Maya Gomez: Quick review left on PR  asked for a one-line changelog in the PR body and confirmation that the image is CC-BY from design.
Ethan Cole: Added changelog "Rehost apex-arch image; add custodian: docs-apex" and confirmed design license. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-3977.docs-site.redwood.ai/apex/runbook shows image loading.
Nadia Rivera: Verified preview. LGTM.
Maya Gomez: Merged and closed DOC-1205. Added a short note at the top of runbook: "If you see link-rot, ping #docs or open a DOC ticket."
Ethan Cole: Thanks folks, closing thread. :tada:
